decision.observed_event: Twenty-one, 25 gp a side. Your cards: 7 of diamonds and 2 of spades, 9. The dealer shows the 4 of hearts. Hit or stand?

improv_read.player_bid: Wren lowers her bet and asks to play it out and hit.
improv_read.connection: Uktarl wants a seated player in a game he deals.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit keeps the round moving with a short table moment and the hit-or-stand choice.

public_brief.objective: Keep her playing hands he controls.
public_brief.tactic: Deal crisply and tease her eagerness to hit.
public_brief.visible_cue: Two cards slide to her; he flicks his up-card over.
public_brief.reply_to: Fine, twenty, and I'll play it out. Hit.
public_brief.kit_focus: Give the deal one quick physical beat and the fresco-side player's glance, then hand the decision back.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, tight, dry humor: quick deal and a tease

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Two cards slide across the wood to you, quick and flat, and the dealer flips his own up-card with a flick of one long nail. The fresco-side player leans in to see, then leans back, unimpressed.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: A modest start, my lady, nothing to weep over and nothing to sing about. The house shows a small card and a patient face. You asked for a card before you had even seen these. Do you still want it?
